scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names 'REDIS,WORKER,BACKEND,FRONTEND' -c 'bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgYellow.bold,bgCyan.bold' "redis-server --port 6379" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:worker: cd backend && rq worker --url redis://localhost:6379/0 ocr_queue
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.install:all: yarn install && cd backend && uv sync
